title: Finitely generated ideal for a quasi-finite degree sublevel locus on an affine open
statement: Under the flat, locally finitely presented, separated, quasi-finite hypotheses and the universal degree criterion, the degree-≤r locus restricted to an affine open W is the zero locus of a finitely generated ideal of Γ(S,W).

source.place: More on Morphisms, Tag 07RZ, proof, second paragraph

proof.text: Identify the affine open with the spectrum of its coordinate ring. Express the closed sublevel locus as the vanishing locus of an ideal, descend the finite locally free degree-r morphism along the filtered system of finitely generated subideals, and use the universal degree criterion to obtain a finitely generated subideal with the same vanishing locus.
